subject: english
question: Based on your reading of the passage, select the correct statement.

options.text: Learning environment should be challenging for the youth.
No obstacles in freedom will make responsible adults.
Young people are more receptive to friends.
There should be no checks and balances in adolescence.

solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Young people are more receptive to friends'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct statement after reading the passage is: **'Young people are more receptive to friends'.**
 
• As this is clearly mentioned in the passage:** '****We open up to friends and younger people more. Adults ought to encourage us to keep these close friendships rather than worrying about how far apart we are from them'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Learning environment should be challenging for the youth'** is not the correct statement according to the passage.
 
• **'No obstacles in freedom will make responsible adults'** is not the correct statement according to the passage.
 
• **'There should be no checks and balances in adolescence'** is not the correct statement according to the passage.
